summary: TODO-003 satisfies the approved acceptance criteria. The SUN crypto module, server-only key wrapper, API branch, Supabase migration, and atomic record_sun_tag path align with the requirements, and the supplied validation evidence is sufficient. I found no blocking issues.
evidence: Read mandatory reviewer rules and task artifacts: request.md, plan.md, analysis.md, todos/TODO-003.md, implementation/TODO-003.md, and state.json.
Inspected src/lib/sun.ts: implements AES-CMAC, PICCData decrypt, SV2 session MAC key derivation, SDMMAC truncation, UID-based file-key diversification, and timing-safe MAC comparison.
Inspected src/lib/sun-keys.ts: imports server-only and reads SUN_META_KEY/SUN_MASTER_KEY lazily from server env vars.
Inspected src/app/api/tag/route.ts: SUN payloads {e,c} are verified before calling store.recordSunTag; token path remains unchanged for TODO-004.
Inspected src/lib/db.ts: recordSunTag calls the record_sun_tag RPC and maps results through the shared tag result conversion.

Inspected supabase/migrations/20260927140000_sun.sql: adds baseline fields, sun_counters with primary key (uid, ctr), RLS/privilege restrictions, and record_sun_tag with counter consumption, baseline rejection, and race-rule checks in one transaction.
Ran npm run test:sun locally: 11/11 tests passed, including AN12196 vectors, tampered MAC, wrong keys, malformed inputs, diversification, and counter boundaries.
Reviewed runtime/static/TODO-003/summary.txt: VALIDATE_STATUS=PASSED, tsc exit 0, lint baseline matched.

Reviewed API evidence api-check-sun.local.out.txt: AC2-AC6 and AC8 checks passed, including fresh SUN success, replay rejection, same-payload concurrency, different-counter concurrency, baseline rejection, bad MAC, unregistered UID, and race-rule parity.
Reviewed anon/RLS and bundle-scan evidence: anon/authenticated denied sun_counters and record_sun_tag; client/static bundle scans reported zero key/value hits.
regressions_checked: Token tag path regression evidence passed in api-check-sun.local.out.txt and regression-api-check.local.out.txt.
Existing TODO-001 race-rule behavior for not-live, duplicate, out-of-order, finish, rankings, unknown tag, and cascade deletion was covered by regression evidence.
Missing SUN env check confirms SUN path returns generic 503 while token path remains unaffected.
Browser runtime validation was not required for TODO-003 because this Todo changes API/server behavior only; TODO-004 covers UI SUN flow.
